observations.behavior: Adds an optional onAdvance prop to NextButton, SDKInstructionsModal, and ManualSetupButton, allowing callers to override the default onboarding step machine and execute their own callback instead.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows self-driving onboarding flows to bypass the legacy onboarding step machine and execute their own callback, while still retaining the ability to skip installation and report the skip event.
